standard_prerequisites.name: The category of finitely presented modules over a filtered colimit of rings is the colimit of the categories of finitely presented modules over the stages
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces the description of finitely presented modules to the stagewise description.

standard_prerequisites.name: The category of flat finitely presented modules is likewise the colimit of the corresponding stagewise categories, and relative perfectness is characterized by a structure statement for such modules
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces part (1) by taking a representative of the relatively perfect object at some stage.

standard_prerequisites.name: The Hom complex between a pseudo-coherent complex and a complex of finite tor dimension is a bounded below complex with flat terms whose cohomology computes the Hom groups, and tensor products commute with filtered colimits which are exact
standard_prerequisites.use: Computes the Hom groups over the colimit as the colimit of the Hom groups over the stages, which is part (2).

core_obligations: Use the description of finitely presented modules over a filtered colimit of rings as the colimit of the stagewise categories, and the corresponding description for flat finitely presented modules, to conclude from the structure characterization of relative perfectness that a relatively perfect object over the colimit comes by base change from a relatively perfect object at some stage (proof lines 22129-22140).

For part (2), choose explicit representatives of the two given objects as in the computation of the Hom complex for a pseudo-coherent complex and a complex of finite tor dimension, and record that the cohomology of that Hom complex after base change computes the Hom groups over each stage and over the colimit (proof lines 22142-22156).

Conclude by the commutation of the tensor product with filtered colimits and exactness of filtered colimits, which identifies the group over the colimit with the colimit of the groups over the stages (proof lines 22156-22160).

Read off the final statement of the lemma, namely that the triangulated category of relatively perfect complexes over the colimit is the colimit of the triangulated categories over the stages, as the combination of the two numbered assertions (proof lines 22122-22126).
proof_roadmap: Pass to the stagewise categories of finitely presented and of flat finitely presented modules (proof lines 22129-22140).
Use the structure characterization of relative perfectness to descend the object to a stage (proof lines 22136-22140).
Compute the Hom groups through the explicit Hom complex and conclude with the commutation of tensor products with filtered colimits (proof lines 22142-22160).
difficulty_reason: The statement concerns a filtered colimit of rings with a flat finitely presented algebra over an initial stage and the induced algebras over the stages, and asserts that relatively perfect objects descend to a stage and that Hom groups between base changed objects are the colimits of the Hom groups over the stages, whence the triangulated category of relatively perfect complexes over the colimit is the colimit of the stagewise categories (statement lines 22104-22127). The proof identifies the categories of finitely presented modules, and then of flat finitely presented modules, over the colimit with the colimits of the stagewise categories, applies the structure characterization of relative perfectness to descend the object to a stage, and computes the Hom groups through the explicit Hom complex whose cohomology is compatible with base change, concluding with the commutation of tensor products with filtered colimits (proof lines 22129-22160). The two category identifications and the Hom complex computation are the substance of the argument. The counted span refers five times, twice to results of this chapter and three times to other chapters, all carried as navigation stubs.
